title: AntennaPod Late-Night Listening Trend
app: Jellyfin, Emby, Steam, Steam Deck logs, Xbox and Nintendo exports, Tautulli, AntennaPod, RetroArch, and the *arr stack via official APIs, local databases, webhook payloads, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=antennapod:episode state=played
| eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H"))
| where hour>=23 OR hour<2
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(listened_min) as late_night_minutes by podcast _time
| sort - late_night_minutes
description: Uses AntennaPod play history telemetry to monitor how much podcast listening happens late at night in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for shows most associated with sleep-time listening, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest AntennaPod play history data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Weekly podcast chart of late-night minutes.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers how much podcast listening happens late at night so you can spot shows most associated with sleep-time listening before it becomes annoying.
